body:
```python
# Test empty string
assert parse_qsl_("") == [], (parse_qsl_(""), [])

# Test single key-value pair
assert parse_qsl_("a=1") == [("a", "1")], (parse_qsl_("a=1"), [("a", "1")])

# Test multiple key-value pairs
assert parse_qsl_("a=1&b=2") == [("a", "1"), ("b", "2")], (parse_qsl_("a=1&b=2"), [("a", "1"), ("b", "2")])

# Test blank value (key=)
assert parse_qsl_("a=") == [("a", "")], (parse_qsl_("a="), [("a", "")])

# Test blank value with multiple pairs
assert parse_qsl_("a=&b=2") == [("a", ""), ("b", "2")], (parse_qsl_("a=&b=2"), [("a", ""), ("b", "2")])

# Test component with no '=' yields empty value
assert parse_qsl_("a") == [("a", "")], (parse_qsl_("a"), [("a", "")])

# Test component with no '=' among multiple
assert parse_qsl_("a&b=2") == [("a", ""), ("b", "2")], (parse_qsl_("a&b=2"), [("a", ""), ("b", "2")])

# Test '+' decoded as space
assert parse_qsl_("a=hello+world") == [("a", "hello world")], (parse_qsl_("a=hello+world"), [("a", "hello world")])

# Test '+' in key
assert parse_qsl_("hello+world=1") == [("hello world", "1")], (parse_qsl_("hello+world=1"), [("hello world", "1")])

# Test percent-escape decoding
assert parse_qsl_("a=%20") == [("a", " ")], (parse_qsl_("a=%20"), [("a", " ")])

# Test percent-escape for non-space character
assert parse_qsl_("a=%41") == [("a", "A")], (parse_qsl_("a=%41"), [("a", "A")])

# Test multiple percent-escapes
assert parse_qsl_("a=%41%42%43") == [("a", "ABC")], (parse_qsl_("a=%41%42%43"), [("a", "ABC")])

# Test mixed '+' and percent-escapes
assert parse_qsl_("a=hello+%20world") == [("a", "hello  world")], (parse_qsl_("a=hello+%20world"), [("a", "hello  world")])

# Test only '&' as separator, not ';'
assert parse_qsl_("a=1;b=2") == [("a", "1;b=2")], (parse_qsl_("a=1;b=2"), [("a", "1;b=2")])

# Test ';' in value is not a separator
assert parse_qsl_("a=1&b=2;c=3") == [("a", "1"), ("b", "2;c=3")], (parse_qsl_("a=1&b=2;c=3"), [("a", "1"), ("b", "2;c=3")])

# Test empty components from consecutive '&'
assert parse_qsl_("a=1&&b=2") == [("a", "1"), ("b", "2")], (parse_qsl_("a=1&&b=2"), [("a", "1"), ("b", "2")])

# Test leading '&'
assert parse_qsl_("&a=1") == [("a", "1")], (parse_qsl_("&a=1"), [("a", "1")])

# Test trailing '&'
assert parse_qsl_("a=1&") == [("a", "1")], (parse_qsl_("a=1&"), [("a", "1")])

# Test value with '=' in it (split on first '=')
assert parse_qsl_("a=b=c") == [("a", "b=c")], (parse_qsl_("a=b=c"), [("a", "b=c")])

# Test key with '=' in it (split on first '=')
assert parse_qsl_("a=b=c&d=e") == [("a", "b=c"), ("d", "e")], (parse_qsl_("a=b=c&d=e"), [("a", "b=c"), ("d", "e")])

# Test percent-escape in key
assert parse_qsl_("%41=1") == [("A", "1")], (parse_qsl_("%41=1"), [("A", "1")])

# Test multiple blank values
assert parse_qsl_("a=&b=&c=") == [("a", ""), ("b", ""), ("c", "")], (parse_qsl_("a=&b=&c="), [("a", ""), ("b", ""), ("c", "")])

# Test all blank components
assert parse_qsl_("&&&") == [], (parse_qsl_("&&&"), [])

# Test single blank component
assert parse_qsl_("") == [], (parse_qsl_(""), [])

# Test percent-escape for lowercase hex
assert parse_qsl_("a=%41") == [("a", "A")], (parse_qsl_("a=%41"), [("a", "A")])

# Test percent-escape with mixed case hex
assert parse_qsl_("a=%4a") == [("a", "J")], (parse_qsl_("a=%4a"), [("a", "J")])

# Test invalid percent-escape (not followed by two hex digits)
assert parse_qsl_("a=%") == [("a", "%")], (parse_qsl_("a=%"), [("a", "%")])

# Test invalid percent-escape (only one hex digit)
assert parse_qsl_("a=%4") == [("a", "%4")], (parse_qsl_("a=%4"), [("a", "%4")])

# Test invalid percent-escape (non-hex characters)
assert parse_qsl_("a=%ZZ") == [("a", "%ZZ")], (parse_qsl_("a=%ZZ"), [("a", "%ZZ")])

# Test complex example
assert parse_qsl_("name=John+Doe&age=30&city=New%20York") == [("name", "John Doe"), ("age", "30"), ("city", "New York")], (parse_qsl_("name=John+Doe&age=30&city=New%20York"), [("name", "John Doe"), ("age", "30"), ("city", "New York")])
```
